timeline.text: Before now, a curious kid had no way to ask for an explainer video from inside the family app — the question just went nowhere parents could see.
Now a child holds one button and simply speaks the question.
Text-to-speech reads it back, so the kid can confirm before it's ever queued.
Parents see every question land, and can cancel one still waiting — or type it themselves.
The shared queue is capped at 2 questions per child, every day.
